howToUse: Generated by the build; do not edit this file. It lists every club string the reviewed table does not know yet, most common first.
To adopt one: add its `key` to `aliases` in data/clubs.json pointing at the club's id, or add a new club to `clubs` whose `name` cleans to that key. Then rebuild.
`suggestion` is a rule-based guess only (it ignores brackets, league tags, team colours and SC/FC). It is never applied automatically - two different clubs can share one suggestion.
Nothing here is dropped from the site: an unmatched string is shown and counted as itself.
